input.overview: Af-Tor combines timed orbit gates, two-ball Multiball, and physical outlane savers. Light a lower lane to open its timed upper gate, then complete the green orbit for 1,000 per spin and a timed 2x Baron X-Zone. For Multiball, knock down the Oil Pit target to lock a ball, then shoot the center hole or Water Hole target.
input.simpleOverview: Light a lower lane to open its timed upper gate, then complete the green orbit for 2x Baron X-Zone. Knock down Oil Pit to lock a ball, then shoot the center hole or Water Hole target to start two-ball Multiball.
input.summary: Use a lit lower lane to open the green-gate orbit, cash the short 2x window, and build the separate Oil Pit lock into a center-hole or Water Hole Multiball start.

quickInfo.name: Open Orbit Gate
quickInfo.summary: Score the matching lit lower lane; the upper gate opens briefly.

quickInfo.name: Start 2x
quickInfo.summary: Complete the green-lit orbit while its gate is open.

quickInfo.name: Lock Ball
quickInfo.summary: Knock down the Oil Pit target.

quickInfo.name: Start Multiball
quickInfo.summary: After locking, shoot the center hole or Water Hole target.

steps.text: Score a lit lower lane to open the matching upper orbit gate for a short timer.
Shoot the green-lit orbit through both spinners to start the Baron X-Zone 2x window.
Knock down the Oil Pit target to lock a ball.
With a ball locked, shoot the center hole or Water Hole target to start two-ball Multiball and double playfield scoring.

alternatives.title: Outlane-saver recovery
alternatives.when: Use this after an outlane saver drops and its three-letter relight path is safely available.

steps.text: Spell E-S-C to reset the left saver or A-P-E to reset the right saver.
Verify the physical drop target has risen before relying on it.
Return to the gate or Multiball plan.

buildsToward.title: Two-ball play with a scoring double

steps.text: Open and complete the green orbit for Baron X-Zone.
Knock down Oil Pit and lock the ball.
Start Multiball at the center hole or Water Hole and use the doubled playfield.

machineSetup: Identify early versus later hardware, then test both upper gates, both spinners, lower gate-light lanes, Oil Pit lock, center hole, Water Hole, and all three programmable drop targets.
Confirm lock memory, the left-outlane saver-at-ball-start setting, Extra Ball and Special conversion, and both timed-scoring durations.

playfieldReferences.label: Green-gate orbit
playfieldReferences.description: Timed upper orbit through both spinners that starts Baron X-Zone.

playfieldReferences.label: Oil Pit lock target
playfieldReferences.description: Drop target used to lock a ball for two-ball Multiball.

playfieldReferences.label: Center Multiball start
playfieldReferences.description: Kickout hole that releases the lock and starts Multiball.

playfieldReferences.label: Outlane drop-target savers
playfieldReferences.description: Physical drain blockers relit by E-S-C and A-P-E.

cautions.issue: Early and later Af-Tor hardware differ, and lock memory plus the left saver are operator-adjustable.
cautions.response: Test the physical saver coils and inspect settings before relying on stored locks or a saver at ball start.
